Interaction.title: Interaction
Interaction.description: A multi-turn journal entry or reflection conversation isolated to an authenticated user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the interaction document.

userId.description: The UID of the owning authenticated user.

title.description: Short title or topic summarizing the entry.

content.description: The user reflection or prompt text.

response.description: The AI response containing reflections, brainstorming, or summary.

mode.description: Interaction mode: reflect, summarize, or brainstorm.

Embedding.title: Embedding
Embedding.description: 768-dimensional vector embedding and associated text chunk for semantic search, strictly owned by the authenticated user with document ID equal to interaction ID.

id.description: Unique identifier for the embedding document, strictly equal to the parent interactionId for direct 1:1 join.

userId.description: The UID of the owning authenticated user.

interactionId.description: Reference ID to the parent journal interaction (matches document ID).

vector.description: 768-dimensional normalized unit vector generated by gemini-embedding-001 with task_type RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT.

taskType.description: Task type used for embedding generation (RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT).

normalized.description: Whether vector was normalized to unit length via explicit normalize helper.

AdminMetadata.title: AdminMetadata
AdminMetadata.description: Aggregated system metrics and health diagnostics accessible exclusively by elevated roles via custom claims.

totalInteractionsCount.description: Aggregate count of journal interactions across system.

SecurityEvent.title: SecurityEvent
SecurityEvent.description: Server-side audit log of detected prompt injection attempts, written via Admin SDK only. Client read and write are strictly prohibited in security rules.

id.description: Unique identifier for security event document.

uid.description: The UID of the user whose input contained the flagged pattern.

sourceRoute.description: API route where injection pattern was intercepted (/api/reflect or /api/ask).

excerpt.description: Truncated excerpt of flagged input (maximum 200 characters). Never persists full content.

/users/{userId}/interactions/{interactio.description: Private journal reflections and multi-turn interactions strictly isolated to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/embeddings/{embeddingId}.description: Vector embeddings of user reflections, strictly stored under users/{uid}/ and covered by the same owner-bound security rules as raw content.

/admin/metadata/{docId}.description: Aggregate system metrics accessible only to admins with verified server-side custom claims. No admin path can read individual user entry content.

/security_events/{eventId}.description: Top-level security audit logs written server-side via Admin SDK. Clients have zero read and write permission in Firestore rules.
